response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), benchmarks AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count, AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(tc.transaction_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(1.0 * tc.transaction_count / b.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(tc.transaction_count - b.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN benchmarks AS b WHERE tc.transaction_count > b.average_count

assumptions.assumption: A NULL tradekind is an unknown type and is excluded from the counts and benchmarks.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL tradekind as its own group when calculating counts and benchmarks.
